title: Cash Pickup Service Terms: Holding Several Transfers at Once
content:
**Clause 1. Number of transfers.** A customer may hold any number of Cash Pickup transfers at once. Paloma sets no limit on how many Cash Pickup transfers one customer holds. The only bounds are the aggregate sending limits of the customer's Personal Sender Account and the per-recipient frequency cap for Cash Pickup bookings.

**Clause 2. Each booking stands alone.** Each Cash Pickup booking has its own:

- confirmation number;
- Paloma Pickup Number;
- principal;
- fees;
- exchange rate;
- pickup window.

**Clause 3. No combined pickups.** Cash Pickup transfers are never combined into one pickup. A recipient who collects two transfers presents each Pickup Number separately.

**Clause 4. No spill-over.** A refund, a name correction or a reactivation on one Cash Pickup transfer never touches another transfer.

## Clauses 3 and 4 applied (hypothetical case)

A customer holds two hypothetical Cash Pickup transfers to the same recipient, each ready for pickup.

| Situation | Effect under these clauses |
|---|---|
| The recipient arrives to collect both | Each transfer is paid against its own Pickup Number, presented separately |
| The first transfer's recipient name is corrected | Only the first transfer's name changes; the second keeps its own name |
| The first transfer expires and is reactivated | Only the first transfer is reactivated; the second keeps its own window |
| The second transfer is refunded | The refund concerns only the second transfer's money |
